resources.string: Use the username, password and device name above. Accept creates the account and signs in on this device.
HTTP is unencrypted. Your invite, password, device token and prompts can be read on the network.
Enter a valid invite link or token.
Select a server above before entering a bare invite token.
Sign in explicitly to the destination server above, then open the invite again. Your current credential will not be sent there.
Your account changed. Open the invite again and check the destination.
This invite could not be used. It may have expired or already been used. Check your account details before opening it again.
Open the invite again to retry. It was cleared from memory.
The invite was accepted. Refresh Account to finish, or sign in again if required. Do not redeem the invite again.
The account was created, but local setup did not finish. Sign in above to finish setup. Do not redeem the invite again.
